top_story_headline: Attacker hijacks Axios npm maintainer, ships cross-platform RAT to both 1.x and 0.x branches within 39 minutes
top_story_comment: 10 million weekly downloads compromised. Axios is in basically every Node.js project that makes HTTP calls — which is every Node.js project. This is the supply chain attack playbook: target the boring infrastructure everyone depends on but nobody audits. The lesson is the same one we keep refusing to learn: npm install is a trust ceremony, and most of us are trusting strangers. Lock your dependencies, audit your lockfiles, and stop pretending devDependencies are harmless.
